Message:
And just like that,
Elaine was gone...
Off to save the one she loves.

The rest of us ended up
scattered across different worlds,
but another Successor of the Staff
was able to bring us back together.

I was reunited with Morgana,
Artoria, and even Myrlennia...
Thank goodness...
I couldn’t be happier...

I wasn’t able to do
anything for you,
but I should’ve held you
just a bit tighter.

I couldn’t see it then...
but you must have been
hurting so much after
losing the one you loved...

I can’t say I completely
understand how you must feel,
and I can’t heal or
take away your sorrow.

Because, I don’t have
any real power...

But, even if that
were the case, please...
Let me take you
in my arms one more time.

You told me once, didn’t you?
That you’d be heartbroken
if you lost me?
Of course, I feel
the same way about you.

So before you take that final step,
towards the path of no return,
let me stop you.

I just want us to all be
together again,
like we used to be.
That’s all I could ever wish for...
